# Code of Conduct

Concepts is a place to learn, so everyone is welcome here, whatever their experience.

## What we expect

- Be kind and patient, especially with people who are new to a topic.
- Critique code and ideas, never people.
- Assume good intent, and ask before you assume.
- Respect a "no", whether it is to a feature, a pull request or a conversation.

## What isn't acceptable

Harassment, insults, discriminatory jokes or language, personal attacks, sharing someone's private information without permission, and sexual content or attention. This applies in issues, pull requests, discussions and anywhere else you represent the project.

## Reporting

Open a [private security advisory](https://github.com/ike5/concepts/security/advisories/new) marked "Code of Conduct", or contact the maintainer through their [GitHub profile](https://github.com/ike5). Reports are kept confidential. The maintainer may edit or remove content, and warn or ban anyone who breaks this code.
